entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lawrence John Lumley Dundas, 2nd Marquess of Zetland, styled Lord Dundas until 1892 and Earl of Ronaldshay between 1892 and 1929, was a British hereditary peer and Conservative politician. An expert on India, he served as Secretary of State for India in the late 1930s.
